purpose: Test a deformation-aware tabular control without retraining image networks or claiming to identify the cause of the original null CNN result.
inputs: Existing hash-bound ANTs forward nonlinear displacement fields and the existing fixed Harvard-Oxford-to-2009c atlas bridge.
features: Mean log determinant in bilateral hippocampal atlas labels 109 and 119
Mean log determinant in bilateral anterior parahippocampal label 34; not equated with entorhinal cortex
Whole-template-brain interquartile range of log determinant
jacobian: ANTs create_jacobian_determinant_image on the saved reference grid; positive finite determinants only; require >=99 percent positive finite within brain and each region.
tuning: Same original five outer partitions; 3 inner event/treatment-stratified folds; alpha 0.1,1,10; one-SE rule.
limitations: Fixed regional/distribution summaries do not exhaust spatial deformation information and are not equivalent to a Jacobian input channel or a pretrained encoder comparison. The atlas bridge is approximate automatic anatomical labeling; no clinical localization claim.
